decisive_spans.text: Multinucleated giant cells between necrotic tissue
lymphocytes and plasma cells with occasional Russell bodies and eosinophils

response.rationale: The presence of multinucleated giant cells, lymphocytes, plasma cells, and eosinophils in the brain biopsy, along with elevated inflammatory markers and extensive white matter changes, strongly supports Neurosarcoidosis. The absence of vasculitis and negative special stains for TB and fungal infection further rule out other conditions. While Rheumatoid Meningitis is supported by high CCP antibody and thick exudate, it lacks the specific granulomatous features seen in the biopsy.
